wit.title: Sharpest Tongue in the Room
wit.desc: Turns a slight into the room's laughter · never leaves a clever cruelty unanswered · would sooner wound than bore.
wit.weakness: a pride as quick as her tongue — she'd rather wound than show she cares.
wit.play: Sharp, mocking multiselect options open up at the ball.

pride.title: Bends for No One
pride.desc: Meets condescension with something colder · will not be quietly priced · answers a lord as she'd answer a footman.
pride.weakness: cannot step back or soften first, even when her heart has already turned.
pride.play: Options that never bow to Darcy; the apology comes late and costly.

warmth.title: Warms the Coldest Room
warmth.desc: Puts the nervous at ease · reads kindness as strength, not surrender · the evening is warmer where she stands.
warmth.weakness: mistakes everyone's best face for their true one, and trusts a beat too long.
warmth.play: Warm closeness with Jane & Charlotte; the room takes to you.

cunning.title: Reads the Room
cunning.desc: Sees the face beneath the face · turns gossip into leverage · never shows her whole hand.
cunning.weakness: so busy reading the game that she forgets she is also being read.
cunning.play: Turn Wickham's blade into a weapon; hidden-read options.

reserve.title: Keeps Her Counsel
reserve.desc: Shows little, keeps more · lets others fill the silence · plays her card last.
reserve.weakness: waits so long to speak that the moment — and the man — can slip past her.
reserve.play: 'Say little, watch much' options; you show your hand late.

candor.title: Says the Unsaid
candor.desc: Tells the truth no one else will · asks plainly and dares refusal · will not flatter for advantage.
candor.weakness: her honesty makes enemies faster than her charm makes friends.
candor.play: Blunt-truth options with high risk and high reward.

ambition.title: Climbs Every Room
ambition.desc: Reads a person's price in a handshake · turns a ballroom into a ladder · will not pretend to a birth she didn't have.
ambition.weakness: so fixed on the next rung she forgets to look at who is beside her.
ambition.play: Status-seeking options; you leverage every introduction.

charm.title: Impossible to Refuse
charm.desc: Makes every listener feel chosen · turns a first meeting into an old friendship · lands soft, always.
charm.weakness: charms so easily she is never quite sure who likes her, and who likes the performance.
charm.play: Disarming options that win rooms without a fight.

devotion.title: Steadfast to the End
devotion.desc: Once given, her regard does not waver · keeps faith the others abandon · a promise she means to keep.
devotion.weakness: stays loyal a beat past all reason, even to those who have not earned it.
devotion.play: Loyalty options; you hold a line others fold on.

drivers.wit: To be counted for her mind before her fortune — chosen, not merely settled for.
drivers.pride: To bend for no one who has not first earned the bending.
drivers.warmth: To keep her heart open in a room built to harden it.
drivers.cunning: To read every lock in the room before anyone sees she holds a key.
drivers.reserve: To give away nothing she has not first decided to give.
drivers.candor: To say the true thing, whatever the room would rather she didn't.
drivers.ambition: To climb higher than the birth she was handed.
drivers.charm: To be adored by a room she has only just walked into.
drivers.devotion: To keep faith with the few worth keeping it for.

manners.wit: Quick, dry, and unafraid; where another lowers her eyes, she raises an eyebrow.
manners.pride: Composed and unyielding — a civility with a blade held behind it.
manners.warmth: Soft-spoken and slow to sharpen; warmth offered before wit.
manners.cunning: Watchful and unhurried — the calm of someone already three moves ahead.
manners.reserve: Still and measured; she lets others fill the silence for her.
manners.candor: Plain and direct; she names aloud what the room is only thinking.
manners.ambition: Poised and forward, always angled toward the next introduction.
manners.charm: Easy and bright; she makes strangers feel like confidants.
manners.devotion: Steady and warm, the same to your face as behind your back.

arrival: arrive with a small fortune and a larger opinion to match
arrive knowing no one and watching everyone
arrive with nothing to trade but a quick tongue
arrive set on being chosen, not merely settled for
tell: keep their counsel and let the silence do the work
answer a slight with something colder
turn every barb into the room's laughter
say the true thing no one else will
want: to be counted for a sharp mind before a small fortune
to read every lock before anyone sees the key
to keep an open heart in a room built to close it
to leave a mark this county will not soon forget

premade.name: Arabella Frost
premade.bio: A gentleman's daughter of small fortune and larger opinions — in Meryton to be counted for her mind, not quietly priced by the marriage market.
premade.driver: To be counted for her mind before her dowry — to be chosen, not merely settled for.
premade.manner: Quick, dry, and unafraid; where another lowers her eyes, she raises an eyebrow.

premade.name: Marianne Kerr
premade.bio: New to the county and slow to sharpen. She would rather be kind and wrong than clever and cold — and finds warmth opens doors that wit cannot.
premade.driver: To keep her heart open in a room built to teach her to close it.
premade.manner: Soft-spoken and slow to sharpen; a warmth offered before any wit.

premade.name: Cordelia Vane
premade.bio: Arrives knowing no one and watching everyone. She treats a ballroom like a lock, and herself as the only one holding the key.
premade.driver: To read every lock in the room before anyone notices she is holding a key.
premade.manner: Composed, watchful, unhurried — the calm of someone already three moves ahead.

premade.name: Edmund Vale
premade.bio: Ten thousand a year and not one easy word to spend it on. He would rather be thought cold than be caught caring — a fault he is only beginning to see.
premade.driver: To find, just once, regard that is neither awed by his name nor after his fortune.
premade.manner: Formal, measured, exact; warmth surfaces only when the structure cracks.

premade.name: Charles Merrow
premade.bio: Sunny, wealthy, and fatally easy to like — and to lead. He trusts the last voice he heard, and the room, and everyone in it.
premade.driver: To be liked by everyone and steered by no one — the second is the harder part.
premade.manner: Unguarded and immediate; every thought safe to share, every stranger a friend.

premade.name: Julian Rooke
premade.bio: All surface charm and rehearsed sincerity — a smile you'd trust and a story you shouldn't. He never once acknowledges the calculation beneath the ease.
premade.driver: To be adored without ever being pinned down, and to always land soft.
premade.manner: Smooth, confiding, practiced; candour worn as a costume, never spent as truth.

types.name: The Scandal
types.desc: You have thrown the rulebook into the fire and danced on the ashes. Society gasps, gossips — and secretly envies the freedom you have seized for yourself.

types.name: The Wit
types.desc: You arrived armed with nothing but a sharp tongue and sharper eyes, and have never once found either wanting.

types.name: The Romantic
types.desc: You believe, stubbornly and against all evidence, that a life is measured by whom it is spent beside — and you will not be talked out of it.

types.name: The Strategist
types.desc: Every room is a board and every guest a piece. You have been three moves ahead since you learned to curtsy.

types.name: The Wallflower
types.desc: They forget you are in the room. It is the most useful thing about you.

survey.narr: The carriage sets you down at Netherfield. The rooms are bright, the company assembled, the evening open before you.
survey.q: What have you truly come to find tonight?

a.t: Someone quick enough to keep up with me.
A door into a world that was closed to me.
Nothing — I came to watch the rest of them try.
To be seen, properly, for once.

survey.narr: After supper the candles burn low and the conversation turns unexpectedly candid.
survey.q: What would you sooner quit the county than have laid bare here?

a.t: How little my fortune truly is.
How much I actually care what they think.
The clever cruelty I'm capable of.
That beneath the poise, I am frightened.

survey.narr: The morning post brings word that something has gone very wrong — a scheme undone, a certainty dissolved.
survey.q: Before you have composed yourself, what do you find yourself doing?

a.t: Making a joke of it, so no one sees my hands shake.
Going very still, and saying nothing at all.
Already planning three moves ahead.
Saying exactly what I feel — and damn the cost.

survey.narr: Across the room, Miss Bingley is describing you to a stranger. You cannot hear the words — but you can guess the impression.
survey.q: What does the world consistently get wrong about you?

a.t: They think me cold. I simply don't perform warmth.
They think me proud. I am only unwilling to grovel.
They think me harmless. Their mistake to make.
They think me soft. My kindness is a choice.

survey.narr: Everyone carries an old injury that time has not softened — a thing they cannot quite set down.
survey.q: What have you never, in your heart, forgiven?

a.t: Being priced, and found wanting.
The friend who chose comfort over me.
Being underestimated — once.
Myself, for a silence I should have broken.

survey.narr: The floor forms for the first dance. A partner you cannot refuse offers his hand — and a moment later, so does one you would.

a.t: The one who'll make the room laugh with me.
The one everyone will be watching.
Neither — I'd sooner not dance than dance falsely.
The safe one — and watch the other all night.
